title: MV Overworld enemy behavior and custom battle transition gifs

posts.author: Licco
posts.body:
Does anyone have any plugin reccomendations for this?
You've probably seen this in OMORI and Deltarune.
The enemies are on the overworld either stationary or walking a specific path until the player gets in range and they give a (!) bubble and begin to chase them until contact.
Upon contact a battle transition effect (Custom) happens and the scene changes to the battle screen.
The enemy has three phasesd so to speak.
Rest/Patrol(when left alone), Alert(once the player is in range), and chase(they'll follow the player so long as they are on the same map and if touched, they'll start the battle.
As for the battle transitions, i was wondering if there was a plugin to just start battles with a gif, for my game i want to use a fake error screen before the screen is completley covered by popups and then fades to white, then to the battle.
Any help is really apreciated^^

posts.author: RCXGaming
posts.body:
Transition effect plugin:
Gradient Wipe by Tsukimi
.
Enemy gets alerted when you're close to them plugin:
Moghunter's Sensor plugin, included as part of his master demo
.
Gradient Wipe allows you to change out the battle transition, even on the fly during the middle of the game.
The sensor plugin allows you to set it so enemies only get alerted when you're close to them.
